The '''University Faculty Medical Center''', abbreviated to '''UFMC''', was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aurin Leith]] worked in the emergency department prior to joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="Do No Harm">''{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm|reprint=1}}''</ref>
